luna-low.idea: Factor 80325 as 17 · 4725. If n < 17, then n! is too small to be divisible by 80325; show this by bounding n! ≤ 16! < 80325.

terra-high.idea: Assume that n is less than 17 and check each possible value. In every case, n! is not divisible by 80325.

terra-from-idea-only.idea: Assume n is less than 17, then check each possible value directly: none of the corresponding factorials is divisible by 80325.
